subject: problems with plotRle and plotNuse commands

messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: problems with plotRle and plotNuse commands
parts:
Hi,
I have been trying to get out the RLE and NUSE values (not the boxplot
summaries) and so copied the code from the plotNuse and plotRle
commands, and I think there's a problem for the ExonRmaPlm model (for
merge=T). Below is what I think replicates the plotRle code (for
example) if subset=NULL, except instead of doing getData for each file
separately, I'm getting them as one singe matrix.

cesEnsbGBM<-getChipEffects(plmEnsbGBM)
cdfMonoEnsb<-getCdf(cesEnsbGBM)
nbrOfUnits<-nbrOfUnits(cdfMonoEnsb)
units<-1:nbrOfUnits
avgLE <- getAverageLog(cesEnsbGBM, field = "intensities", indices =
NULL, verbose = verbose)
medianLE <- getData(avgLE, indices = units, "intensities")$intensities
medianLE <- log2(medianLE)
rleGBM <- getData(cesEnsbGBM, indices = units,"intensities")
$intensities
rleGBM <- log2(rleGBM)
rleGBM <- rleGBM-medianLE

Then for avgLE, I get -Inf values (after the log2); I think they
correspond to the 'blank' storage places (with merge=T, only 1 of the
group slots stores anything and the rest are blank). Unlike the
extractMatrix commands, it's not weeding out these blank storage
places. I don't know an elegant way to fix this. I'm just going to do
indices for the -Inf values and weed them out that way.

If I'm correct, this seriously effects our interpretation of what
we've been plotting for quality control!

Best,
Elizabeth

Yes, that seems to be an error. The symptoms you guestimate seem reasonable.

For other's information, Elizabeth is working on a solution offline
that we'll try to get into the next release. Note that the problem
occurs when groups are merged, i.e. if you don't fit the PLM with
merge=TRUE (or combineAlleles=TRUE), you should be fine.
